title: DUI Arrest Escalates As Mother Attacks Cop To Save Drunk Teen From Arrest!
description:
On August 27th, 2023, an officer in New Mexico responded to a Seargenats call for backup during a traffic stop. Upon the officer's arrival, he observed the Sergeant conducting Standardized Field Sobriety Tests (SFSTs) on a male driver at the front of his patrol car. While continuing the SFSTs, a blue Chevrolet pulled up, and a female exited the passenger side. The female told officers she was the male driver's mother. The driver’s mother rolled her eyes as the officer explained her son was being arrested for DWI.

The situation escalated when the male driver resisted arrest, kicking his legs into the Sergeant's patrol car. As the driver continued resiting the Sergeant, the mother intervened by jumping on the Sergeant's back. The responding officer quickly responded, taking the suspect off the sergeant and detaining her. The female suspect began to verbally and physically confront the law enforcement officers. Despite being restrained, she continued to threaten and fight both the officers.

The male suspect was charged with Aggravated DWI, Resisting, Evading, or Obstructing an Officer and Improper Equipment.

The female suspect was charged with Battery upon a Peace Officer and Resisting, Evading, or Obstructing an Officer.
